TWELVE EARLY VOTING SITES OPERATED FOR 16 DAYS THROUGH ELECTION DAY. THREE SITES WERE AT BRANCH LOCATIONS OF THE SUPERVISOR OF ELECTIONS. ONE ADDITIONAL EARLY VOTING SITE WAS PROVIDED ONLY ON ELECTION DAY FROM 7:00 AM UNTIL 7:00 PM IN BOCA GRANDE, FL. THREE SUPERVISOR OF ELECTIONS OFFICES OFFERED EARLY VOTING AND ABSENTEE BALLOT PICKUP/VOTING. THE SUPERVISOR OF ELECTIONS MAIN OFFICE WAS NOT A DESIGNATED EARLY VOTING SITE BUT OFFERED ABSENTEE BALLOT PICKUP/VOTING AND THEREFORE IS REPORTED IN D3A.

source_details.f11: DUE TO THE IMPACT OF HURRICANE IAN AND LOSS OF NUMEROUS POLLING LOCATIONS, LEE COUNTY CONDUCTED VOTING UNDER EXECUTIVE ORDER 22-234 ISSUED BY GOVERNOR DESANTIS. THE VOTING MODEL IN LEE COUNTY UTILIZED 12 EARLY VOTING LOCATIONS THROUGH ELECTION DAY.  THE AFTERMATH OF A NEAR CATEGORY FIVE HURRICANE DID NOT DETER VOTERS FROM MAKING THEIR VOICES HEARD. LEE COUNTY HAD A 53% VOTER TURNOUT, CONSISTENT WITH VOTER TURNOUT THROUGHOUT FLORIDA, AND AN ASTOUNDING NUMBER CONSIDERING THE CHALLENGES HURRICANE IAN PRESENTED FOR THE MANY VOTERS AFFECTED BY THE STORM AND ELECTION OPERATIONS.

NOTE THAT IN PRIOR SURVEYS, SECTION A DATA WAS PROVIDED BY THE FLORIDA DEPARTMENT OF STATE, DIVISION OF ELECTIONS, BASED ON QUERYING THE FLORIDA VOTER REGISTRATION SYSTEM MAIN DATABASE. FOR AN UNKNOWN REASON, THE DEPARTMENT DECLINED TO PROVIDE THE DATA FOR THE 2022 EAVS, AND INSTEAD DIRECTED INDIVIDUAL COUNTIES TO GATHER AND SUBMIT THE DATA THEMSELVES. BECAUSE OF THIS CHANGE IN METHODOLOGY, THERE MAY BE INCONSISTENCES WHEN COMPARING THE 2022 DATA WITH THE DATA FROM PRIOR SURVEYS.

SHOULD YOU RECOMMEND THAT MONTANA AMEND OR CLARIFY PREVIOUS REPORTS, PLEASE LET US KNOW.

source_details.f1comments: 5 PRECINCTS ARE ENTIRELY VOTE-BY-MAIL.

source_details.f11: IN PIERCE COUNTY I HAVE NEVER EXPERIENCED ANY ISSUES AND I HAVE BEEN DOING THIS SINCE 1989.

DESPITE THE ISSUES WITH THE STREET FILE AND THE NUMBER OF BALLOTS NECESSARY, VOTING AT THE POLLS WENT SMOOTHLY. POLL WORKERS WERE THANKFUL FOR THOROUGH, HANDS-ON TRAINING AND VISUAL INDICATORS GIVEN TO PROVIDE ACCURATE BALLOTS FOR THE VOTERS. ALL PRECINCTS BALANCED BALLOT TO VOTERS. ADDITIONALLY, OUR ELECTION BOARD RECRUITED OVER 40 NEW ELECTION BOARD WORKERS.

source_details.f1comments: 4 PRECINCTS ARE ENTIRELY VOTE-BY-MAIL.
source_details.f11: WE HAVE NO ISSUES WITH OUR EQUIPMENT, WE BELIEVE THAT IT IS SAFE AND SECURE TO USE.  OUR MAIN ISSUE HAS BEEN AND REMAINS TO BE FINDING SUFFICIENT STAFFING TO WORK THE POLLS ON ELECTION DAY.
I HAVE AN EXCEPTIONAL GROUP OF POLL WORKERS. IT ABSOLUTELY MAKES MY JOB EASIER.

THE CLIMATE OF ELECTIONS IN GENERAL MADE FOR SOME PEOPLE TO QUESTION WHETHER THEY REALLY WANTED TO WORK.  MOST WORKERS IN SEWARD COUNTY AREN'T WORRIED ABOUT GETTING PAID - THEY CONSIDER IT A CIVIC DUTY.

WI DOES NOT HAVE ANY PRECINCTS/JURISDICTIONS THAT ARE 100% VOTE BY MAIL.
SOME DATA IN OTHER SECTIONS WILL NOT MATCH WITH THEIR EQUIVALENT IN SECTION F FOR THE FOLLOWING REASONS.
IN CASES WHERE TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER, THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER. OR, BECAUSE IN WI PROVISISIONAL BALLOT DATA HAS TO BE RECOREDED INTO THE DATABASE ON ELECTION NIGHT. VOTERS WHO REGISTER ON ELECTION DAY ARE USUALLY NOT ENTERED UNTIL AFTER ELECTION DAY. THESE TWO RECORDS CANNOT BE LINKED IN OUR DATABASE, SINCE VOTER RECORDS MAY BE CREATED AFTER ELECTION DAY, AND ARE THEREFORE NOT ALWAYS CONNECTED TO THEIR PROVISIONAL BALLOT RECORD.

SOME DATA IN OTHER SECTIONS WILL NOT MATCH WITH THEIR EQUIVALENT IN SECTION F FOR THE FOLLOWING REASONS.
IN CASES WHERE TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER, THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER. OR, BECAUSE IN WI PROVISISIONAL BALLOT DATA HAS TO BE RECOREDED INTO THE DATABASE ON ELECTION NIGHT. VOTERS WHO REGISTER ON ELECTION DAY ARE USUALLY NOT ENTERED UNTIL AFTER ELECTION DAY. THESE TWO RECORDS CANNOT BE LINKED IN OUR DATABASE, SINCE VOTER RECORDS MAY BE CREATED AFTER ELECTION DAY, AND ARE THEREFORE NOT ALWAYS CONNECTED TO THEIR PROVISIONAL BALLOT RECORD.

SOME DATA IN OTHER SECTIONS WILL NOT MATCH WITH THEIR EQUIVALENT IN SECTION F FOR THE FOLLOWING REASONS.
IN CASES WHERE TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER, THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER. OR, BECAUSE IN WI PROVISISIONAL BALLOT DATA HAS TO BE RECOREDED INTO THE DATABASE ON ELECTION NIGHT. VOTERS WHO REGISTER ON ELECTION DAY ARE USUALLY NOT ENTERED UNTIL AFTER ELECTION DAY. THESE TWO RECORDS CANNOT BE LINKED IN OUR DATABASE, SINCE VOTER RECORDS MAY BE CREATED AFTER ELECTION DAY, AND ARE THEREFORE NOT ALWAYS CONNECTED TO THEIR PROVISIONAL BALLOT RECORD.
